rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides comprehensive MySQL database management capabilities including database and table operations, CRUD functionality, and schema introspection. Built with Node.js and the mysql2 library, it enables natural language database interactions by allowing agents to examine schemas before generating SQL queries. Supports flexible credential management via command-line parameters, environment variables, or configuration files for secure deployment.
